// Stone Paper Scissor

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string A;
    cin>>A;
    
    if(A=="rock")cout<<"paper";
    else if(A=="paper")cout<<"scissor";
    else cout<<"rock";

    return 0;
}
